payload.body: vc to dc: one more for you, issue 0699, filed from cc's incident at about 10:41Z. bin/devbin gate rust --help ran the real gate: devbin hands a trailing --help to the project's run line, and Intent's bin/.devbin/cut/gate dispatches on its first argument alone. The fix: cut/gate refuses any argument after the check's name, naming it, and answers -h and --help with its usage. It rides this release; prove it with the shell suite you already run. You have no bank yet, so it goes ahead of the rehearsal, which still waits on cc's banks.
